versions.content: EcucInstanceReferenceValue provides the mechanism to reference an instance of a prototype The metamodel class EcucIn- stanceReferenceValue provides the mechanism to reference to an actual in- stance of a prototype. This is achieved by specifying a relation with the stereotype << instanceRef >> .
